# Link Resolution — ambiguous links, broken links, and KB with many pages

-- alpha-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Alpha Note
summary: First note
tags: linktest
---
Alpha content with [[shared-name]].
-- alpha-note.md --

-- beta-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Beta Note
summary: Second note
tags: linktest
---
Beta content with [[shared-name]].
-- beta-note.md --

-- source-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Source Note
summary: Links to ambiguous target
tags: linktest
---
This links to [[shared-name]] and [[nonexistent-page]].
-- source-note.md --

-- many-pages.md --
---
type: note
title: Many Pages Test
summary: For testing many pages
tags: linktest
---
Page content for bulk test.
-- many-pages.md --

# === INIT ===
exec akb init link-kb
cd link-kb

# === CREATE TWO PAGES WITH SAME BASENAME ===
exec akb write alpha/shared-name.md <../alpha-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/alpha/shared-name.md'

exec akb write beta/shared-name.md <../beta-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/beta/shared-name.md'

# === CREATE SOURCE PAGE WITH AMBIGUOUS AND BROKEN LINKS ===
exec akb write source-note.md <../source-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/source-note.md'

# === LINKS SHOWS AMBIGUOUS AND BROKEN ===
exec akb links notes/source-note.md
stdout 'Ambiguous:'
stdout 'shared-name'
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'nonexistent-page'

# === ORPHANS SHOWS PAGES WITH NO INBOUND LINKS ===
exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/alpha/shared-name.md'
stdout 'notes/beta/shared-name.md'

# === CREATE MANY PAGES ===
exec akb write page-01.md <../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-02.md <../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-03.md <../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-04.md <../many-pages.md
exec akb write page-05.md <../many-pages.md

# === LIST SHOWS ALL PAGES ===
exec akb list
stdout 'notes/page-01.md'
stdout 'notes/page-02.md'
stdout 'notes/page-03.md'
stdout 'notes/page-04.md'
stdout 'notes/page-05.md'

# === STATUS SHOWS CORRECT PAGE COUNT ===
exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 8'

# === SEARCH FINDS PAGES ===
exec akb search 'linktest'
stdout 'notes/source-note.md'
